connector.name: Mimecast
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Mimecast email security: message queue, held messages, domains, and threats.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mimecast-mcp:v1.3.0. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wyre-technology account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

env.name: AUTH_MODE
env.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
